name: @cursor-workflows/dashboard
description: The kit's local dashboard: a local web server over the runs and the metrics of every repo; it reads, and it has four actions: starting a workflow in a repository it knows, resuming a stopped run, approving or replacing the seams an implement-issue run proposed, and cancelling a run.

scripts.typecheck: PATH=../../node_modules/typescript/bin:$PATH; tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p app && tsc --noEmit -p run-view && tsc --noEmit -p test
